verdict.rationale: GitHub feature list confirms 'Pinning Rules (Merchandising)' as a built-in feature, directly supporting curated result pinning, but there is no first-party documentation detailing synonym configuration, boosting specific hits, or hiding/excluding specific results for specific queries. missing for 10: dedicated synonyms documentation, boost-per-hit configuration docs, hide/exclude-hit documentation, and any hands-on example of pin/boost/hide in action beyond the feature list mention.
